title: Labor Code, Division 2, Part 1, Chapter 1, Article 1.5 (Paid Sick Days) - Healthy Workplaces, Healthy Families Act of 2014
verified_how: The LAB Div 2 tree shows 'ARTICLE 1.5. Paid Sick Days 245-249'. §245 says it may be 'cited as the Healthy Workplaces, Healthy Families Act of 2014'. §246 was amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 309 (SB 616), effective 1 Jan 2024.
notes: Paid sick leave. Vacation and holiday pay on termination is §227.3, also in Part 1. California has no statute requiring vacation leave.
